character: Jiraiya the Toad Sage from Naruto (normal form, NOT sage mode): tall muscular man, very long spiky white hair tied back, red lines running down from his eyes, a horned metal forehead protector with the kanji for oil (油), a green short kimono shirt and trousers with mesh armor at the wrists and shins, a red sleeveless haori vest with two yellow circles, a large scroll on his back, wooden geta sandals, confident grin
short: Jiraiya: long spiky white hair, red eye lines, horned 油 headband, green outfit, red haori vest, scroll on his back, geta sandals

base.prompt: confident battle-ready stance FACING RIGHT: his face, chest and extended right arm point toward the RIGHT edge of the canvas, the scroll on his back is on the LEFT side of his body; feet apart, knees slightly bent, right arm extended forward to the right with the palm open, left fist at his hip, long white hair flowing behind him to the left. No effects around him.

idle_in.prompt: a tiny breathing change: inhaling, chest very slightly expanded, both shoulders raised by a few pixels, hair and clothing swaying slightly. Everything else identical.

idle_out.prompt: a tiny breathing change: exhaling, shoulders lowered by a few pixels, head dipped very slightly, hair and clothing swaying slightly the other way. Everything else identical.

idle_m.prompt: shoulders halfway between the two, hair and clothing between the two positions. Everything else identical.

h2.prompt: the pose only: STAGGER after being hit - knocked back half a step: body hunched forward in pain, one hand clutching his stomach, head lowered with a pained grimace. No blood, no effects.

h3.prompt: the pose only: RECOVERING from a hit - straightening back up toward his fighting stance: almost upright but slightly hunched, one arm raised in guard, hurt but determined expression. No blood, no effects.
